subject: Math
subskill: Predict Value Using Line of Best Fit
prompt:
[Figure 1]

Twelve data points are shown in the scatterplot. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. At $x = 300$, which of the following is closest to the y-value predicted by the line of best fit?
explanation: Choice B is correct. On the line of best fit, an x-value of $300$ corresponds to a y-value between $8$ and $10$. Therefore, of the given choices, $9$ is closest to the y-value predicted by the line of best fit at $x = 300$.
